esp32.detail: 3 pins wired; TCST2103 optical endstop module needs at least 4.5 V, so it is powered from 5 V. U2.S → D25 (GPIO25). Added a 10 kΩ / 20 kΩ divider on S: it swings to 5 V, and the D25 pin takes 3.3 V at most. Added the tcst2103_endstop.py driver written from the datasheet.
Reports the endstop triggered when the slot is blocked, open when it clears: passes

pico.detail: 3 pins wired; TCST2103 optical endstop module needs at least 4.5 V, so it is powered from 5 V. U2.S → GP2 (GPIO2). Added a 10 kΩ / 20 kΩ divider on S: it swings to 5 V, and the GP2 pin takes 3.3 V at most. Added the tcst2103_endstop.py driver written from the datasheet.
Reports the endstop triggered when the slot is blocked, open when it clears: passes
